best_idea: Give every client command a client-generated id that the server applies at most once inside a 15 s window, and skip (do not queue) unreliable state while the send queue is busy; never let a repeated burst be the source of a loot, XP or kill outcome.
decision_why: The command-id dedup window gives the one-ledger rule a safe retry after a reconnect, so a retried attack cannot double-hit; the donor's blind 10x repeat is rejected for outcomes because it has no acknowledgement and kills are server-verified.
acceptance: A server test sends the same attack command with one id 10 times within 1.35 s and asserts it applies once (one hit, one ledger entry); and a test with a busy send queue asserts an unreliable state snapshot is skipped and counted, while a reliable event is still queued.
